Our next game, a yuri comedy/horror visual novel, featuring a haunted house, fox-girls, and girl x girl love will also have controller support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1555110/Chasing_Tails_A_Promise_in_the_Snow/


The controllers should work out of the box thanks to Steam Input. You can read more about setting up controllers on Steam [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=6311-RDGM-2712]here[/url]. 

The current main controls are as follows:
D-pad and left stick navigate elements of UI
A (✕) is used to confirm selections, and advances text
B (○) is used to go back and undo actions
X (□) toggles auto mode
Y (▵) hides the UI in reading mode
LB (L1) opens History screen
LT (L2) activates Skip mode. Squeeze it gently!
Pressing left stick (L3) will toggle controller button prompts between Xbox and PS symbols
You can always remap them via Steam’s controller settings!


There’s a limit to how much we can test in-house with just two people and one controller, so if you encounter any problems or have any suggestions on improving how the menus handle with the controller, feel free to get in touch with us!

It's official: [b]Selene ~Apoptosis~[/b], a free horror/romance visual novel we'll be publishing real soon, is a part of the Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition.

notes.title: Updates are here and new languages support is coming soon!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33183180/8b5bc6d59fad091b90e49a1fc6d913c86a878c28.png[/img]

Greetings, adventurers!

Santa got a bit late carrying the update, but now it's yours for the taking! 

This patch includes 2 updates.

1.04 :
- SNEK would stay switched on till the epilogue if you chose the Patrol route - fixed.
- Day/night being displayed incorrectly in the Patrol route - fixed.
- Jiggle animation bug for Ellie in Patrol route - fixed.

1.05 :
- Added scene replay feature. Now you can replay certain IMPORTANT scenes from the Main Menu.
- Lucifelia CG (you'll get it once you'll encounter it) now properly displays outfit damage
- Additional spellchecking, courtesy of Xolf.

We'd like to emphasize our gratitude towards all the amazing people that offer us a hand in hunting bugs and typos. Our community is EVERYTHING! Although we're not always able to do exactly what every particular fan or customer wants, we're always trying to solve the problem they've pointed out.

Speaking of that, how's our 18+ DLC doing? Not well, actually. (But there's a scratch for your itch! Check our Twitter to find out more of what's available right now.) We're still trying our best to deliver an official Steam patch, yet the future is unclear and we can't affect any decisions the store makes. At the moment, rolling a DLC out will get us into the Adult Only category. Our base game has no AO content in it, so that'd clearly be a misplacement resulting in less visibility for the product and more upset customers who never got a proper facesitting. Now, have you visited our Twitter yet? 

If you did, you probably already know we're planning to get you some new languages pretty soon. We should manage to deliver German before the sale goes off, Spanish and Chinese will follow in the next few months.

And that's it for the moment!

Thank you so much for your attention and feedback!
Stay tuned for the further updates and make sure to stay comfy and amused during the holidays!

notes.title: Patch #1, upcoming 18+ free DLC and importance of the reviews!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33183180/36eb8c3132fdcc912c056e5779500104ea693da3.png[/img]

Greetings, adventurers!

[h1]Patch #1 is out[/h1]

[b] Changelog:[/b] 
[list]
    [*]Fixed a bug that would break History screen in the Good Ending
    [*]Changed the CG in the animated version of the Bonfire Lute CG in the gallery to a newer version
    [*]Added an "A" button as a shortcut for auto mode
    [*]Slime scene should now properly unlock in the gallery
[/list]

If you spot any bugs or typos, please make sure to put them here https://steamcommunity.com/app/879510/discussions/0/2656452469257570902/

We'll try our best to fix everything ASAP!


[h1]What's with that DLC?[/h1]

We got much feedback on how to treat adult content and finally made a decision to provide you guys and gals with a free 18+ DLC. It'll take some time to produce, but all in all, it's definitely happening. 

Let's hope we won't get any troubles with product visibility. We really hope Lucy Got Problems will do good and we'll be able to bring more various titles to life!


[h1]The reviews must flow![/h1]

If you have any thoughts on Lucy Got Problems, [b][u]please consider writing a review here on Steam.[/u][/b] 

[b] Why are Steam reviews important?[/b] 
[list]
    [*]They help Steam see our product's not fake and allow trading cards, profile BGs, and emoticons.
    [*]They keep us updated on your opinion and encourage us. 
    [*]They help other users decide if they're interested in what we've got.
[/list]

Even a couple sentences will do a great job, though we'd love to know the details!

Aaand that'll be it for the moment. 

Thank you so much for your attention and feedback!
Stay tuned for the further updates.
